files.positive_domain__domain_io.fsm:
(?fsm:positive_domain__domain_io

  (+system
    (clock clk)
    (sreset rst_n active_low)
  )

  (+interface
    (input request)
    (input allow)
    (input datain)
    (output seen)
    (output done)
  )

  (+size
    (request 1)
    (allow 1)
    (datain 3)
    (seen 3)
    (done 1)
    (can_accept 1)
  )

  (main_idle_0
    (= (can_accept 1))
    (<= (captured datain) <allow)
    (<allow
      (-> main_set_1)
    )
  )

  (main_set_1
    (<- (seen> captured))
    (-> main_done_2)
  )

  (main_done_2
    (<1 (done> 1))
    (-> main_idle_0)
  )

)

(?top:positive_domain_top
  (?ports:public_io
    idle_clk
    clk
    rst_n
    request
    allow
    datain<3
    seen>3
    done>
  )
  (?fsmc:idle positive_domain__domain_idle)
  (?fsmc:io positive_domain__domain_io)
  (?wiring:domain_wiring
    (request io.request)
    (allow io.allow)
    (datain io.datain)
    (io.seen seen)
    (io.done done)
  )
)
